row.notes: mov rcx,rsi before 'mov dl,0xf; call 0x1424192c0' in Game_Settings_OnUseCameraChanged (0x142424860, the settings.current_settings.use_camera.value string callback): r8d = camera enum 0..7 (FNV-1a lowercase of the string: nose_cam 1, nose_cam_alt 2, cockpit_cam 3, tv_pod 4, tv_pod_offset 5, near_chase 6, far_chase 7, other 0), r9b = secondary viewport flag, rsi = settings object. The call is the DifficultySystem setter for setting id 0xf. Static only: whether the in-race camera cycle reaches it is not proven.
